title: SWAP5 WOFOST81 Migration Preservation
non_branch_git_objects_note: Harmless equivalent intermediate commits created during contents/tree ordering; neither is referenced by the PP02 branch or canonical and no force update was used.

validated_semantics: source-faithful WOFOST81 N stress provides stress index and RFRGRL
RFRGRL applies only for DVS<0.2 and LAI<0.75
N-inactive defaults preserve WOFOST81 ageing with NSLLV=1 and RFRGRL=1

architecture_decision: Keep WOFOST81 as an explicit versioned composite path around the unchanged legacy crop owner. The legacy finalizer may supply common carbon/DVS rates, followed by a WOFOST81-only correction layer. The structural leaf update must be versioned because legacy structural evolution performs a second over-age removal that WOFOST81 must not execute after DALV is already included in DRLV.
scientific_interpretation: The WOFOST81 rate surface now reproduces the donor N-stress leaf-death competition and juvenile LAI response without changing the legacy route. The remaining immediate semantic gap is leaf cohort structural application: consume combined DRLV once, age/shift cohorts, add new growth, and omit the legacy second over-age removal.
next_permitted_action: Implement and qualify a WOFOST81-specific leaf cohort structural application that removes corrected combined DRLV exactly once, does not execute legacy second over-age removal, advances surviving cohort age, adds the new leaf cohort with corrected SLA, and remains candidate-only. Then bind this to the versioned composite owner before N request/apply composition.
exclusions: no replacement of existing legacy WOFOST path
